title: Milestone orchestration: audit-trail retention, SSO hardening, and SOC2 sign-off runway
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Coordinate milestone activities required to deliver an audit-trail retention policy, harden SAML SSO integration, and produce the evidence and runbooks needed for SOC2 readiness. Scope includes retention policy design, retention enforcement implementation (storage + lifecycle), access/audit logging enhancements, SSO verification and rekey plan, privacy/legal signoff artifacts, and an evidence playbook for the SOC2 auditor.

Why this ticket: Multiple product and security initiatives share the same milestone deadline for the next compliance intake window. This orchestration ticket ensures cross-team sequencing, clear owners, and a single source of truth for sign-off criteria and artifacts. Deliverables should be consumable by external auditors and self-serveable by internal ops.

Out-of-scope: Full enterprise-wide log centralization (this ticket focuses on inference control plane and customer-facing audit trails); any long-term archival storage beyond the agreed retention window will be scoped separately.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Retention policy documented and approved by Legal & Security (Confluence link in comments). 2) Retention enforcement implemented for audit-trail entries from control plane APIs (storage lifecycle policy in S3/GCS + purge job). 3) SAML SSO upgrades deployed to staging and verified with at least 3 IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin). 4) Audit evidence pack (logs, config snapshots, runbook) generated and validated by Security for SOC2 readiness. 5) QA test plan and regression checks added to CI. 6) No open P0 security findings related to audit logging or SSO at sign-off.
risks: 1) Data retention window requirements may vary by customer jurisdiction—need Legal alignment to avoid rework. 2) Purge/enforcement bugs could lead to accidental deletion or retention beyond policy—require canary + dry-run. 3) SSO provider edge-cases (IdP metadata rotation) may cause outages during rollout. 4) Dependencies on infra tickets ENG-2891 (log export) and ENG-4310 (KMS integration) could delay sign-off.
next_steps: 1) Confirm retention window with Legal by 2025-02-18. 2) ENG to land initial retention enforcement prototype and purge dry-run (ENG-2891). 3) DES to add audit-log visibility components to Console (DES-210). 4) Security to produce evidence checklist and sample artifacts. 5) Schedule cross-team weekly sync and add milestone to 2025-W10 cycle.
